stdout: {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"This command reads $? after piping through a filter (head/tail/grep/sort/uniq/wc/cut/awk/sed). $? captures the last pipeline element — the filter — not the upstream command. Filter commands almost always exit 0, so the check is a silent no-op. Remedies: (1) use ${PIPESTATUS[0]} to read the first command's exit status; (2) drop the pipe and capture a count: n=$(cmd | wc -l); echo $n."}}
